details: 9/9 PROFINET IRT verification checks passed deterministically.

data.gate: Gate G8 Industrial Protocols / Gate G4 Scan Cycle Simulation
data.component: PROFINET IO IRT & MRPD Isochronous Engine

tests.details: Pure ST POU 'ProfinetIrtSync' validated and bound to %R1180..%R1187, %M275..%M276.
Ladder contacts, coils, rungs, and mnemonics intercepted fail-closed with LadderForbiddenError.
Isochronous timing verified across 5 cycles (< 100 ns nominal, phase locked).
DFP 3-subframe container packed (34 bytes) and CRC-16-CCITT validated.
MRPD frame duplication rejected 1 duplicate; seamless Port 1 failover verified (0 us packet loss).
Jitter excursion (1250 ns >= 1000 ns) tripped 0xB601, clearing %M275 and asserting %M276.
Corrupted container frame CRC tripped 0xB602, asserting %M276 and de-energizing %M275.
Dual ring collapse (0xB603) and 65 ms watchdog timeout (0xB604) deterministically trapped.
Full register map %R1180..%R1187 and %M275..%M276 verified in healthy operation.
